description: This file is a PHP class defining the User model for the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for user management such as adding, editing, deleting users, handling login and authorization data, and managing tokens.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A user model class responsible for user CRUD operations, login management, and authorization handling within the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with provided user data, including password hashing.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user record in the database, optionally updating the password.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a specific user identified by user ID.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Removes a user record and associated login and authorization data from the database.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a user by user ID, including user group name.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches user details using the username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves user details by email address.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Fetches user record associated with a specific code.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of users filtered and sorted according to provided criteria.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Returns the total number of users matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Counts users associated with a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Counts users with a particular email address.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a new login event for a user with IP and user agent info.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes all login records for a specific user.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Retrieves login records for a user, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Counts total login records for a user.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates a new authorization record for a user, including token info.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (active/inactive) of a user authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Sets the total number of attempts or authorized actions for a specific authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotalByUserId
methods.description: Sets the total attempts for all authorization records associated with a user.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Removes authorization records for a user; optionally by specific authorization ID.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves a specific authorization record by its ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Fetches an authorization record matching a user ID and token, including attempts count.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Lists authorization records for a user with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts total authorization records for a user.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets the total authorization attempts for a user.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a new token record for user verification or session management.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a token record by its code, invalidating old tokens after 10 minutes.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Removes a token record from the database based on the code.
